SS34 evidence id ESPRESSIF_S3_LCD_EV_BOARD is declared by frozen USB contract rule USB_VBUS_REVERSE_PROTECTION (source_ids). Mapping check (2026-09-02, GH-20 tail): the official ESP32-S3-LCD-EV-Board user guide schematic page 'Power Supply over USB' shows D1 = SS34 in the USB VBUS to USB_5V path; the mapping is corroborated at reference-design level and no frozen contract content change is needed. Per the source classification below, this is authoritative reference design evidence, not exact-component evidence; freezing the SS34 vendor datasheet itself remains W4A (Issue #2).

ESPRESSIF_S3_LCD_EV_BOARD source classification (Owner adjudication 2026-09-02): source_role=authoritative_reference_design; exact_component_evidence=false. applicable_to: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 family reference / USB-C device-side topology / native USB D+/D- reference / BOOT-RESET circuitry / UART auto-download architecture / board-level power-entry and protection reference. not_valid_for: exact ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N8R8 SKU evidence / SHT40 component evidence / 3.3V regulator current-thermal qualification / exact BOM equivalence. Version boundary: the referenced ESP32-S3-LCD-EV-Board revisions use different ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 variants from the project target N8R8 (legacy DigiKey PDF = N16R8; v1.5 = N16R16V with a 1.8V rail and IO47/48 handling absent on this board); therefore the material is authoritative as a reference design, but not as exact-component evidence. The v1.5 regulators (SY8088/ETA3409/ME6211, where ME6211 powers the 1.8V rail) are NOT precedent for this board's AP63203WU-7 3.3V buck.
